name: שְׁאָל
summary: Sheal of the sons of Bani, one of the men listed as having taken foreign wives (Ezr 10:29, 44). He is named only there. The name has the consonants of שָׁאַל “ask”; its form is not one scripture uses for the verb's own words, so whether it means “asking” or is short for a longer name such as Shealtiel cannot be shown.

evidence.note: “Of the sons of Bani: Meshullam, Malluch and Adaiah, Jashub and Sheal (וּשְׁאָל), and Ramoth.”

note: Takes v.ag.ab, one token. The meaning is only the root's; no cognate or verse fixes the form.
